name: Two sources merge
what: Two grey boxes fade in side by side at the top, two thin glowing curves are drawn out of them and flow down into one point, where a conclusion box grows out of a dot, flares with light and has its text typed.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f6-f36 the two source boxes fade in, rise a few pixels and deblur (their names fade in f12-f29); f52-f108 the two curves are drawn out of them, slowly at first and faster and faster, to one point; f106-f118 the conclusion box grows out of a dot while all but the last word of its text is typed; f114-f144 a white rim, a glow and wide light streaks flare around it and settle; f130 the last word is typed; then it holds to the end
